Id.description: Instance id: 10 characters from a-z and 2-7.

LayerState.description:
Per-level rule state for one `auto` layer, stored in `level.json` under
`layers`. A layer without an entry uses the defaults.

optional_groups.description: `optional` rule groups switched on in this level.

seed.description:
Extra seed for this layer's rules in this level. Default 0. The rule
hash already differs per project, level, layer and rule; change this
only to re-roll the layer's random choices in this level.

tilesets.description:
Tileset substitutions in this level: every rule output drawing from
the key tileset draws from the value tileset instead, same
`[col, row]` (LDtk overrideTilesetUid).

Slug.description: snake_case name: a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits or underscores.

description: A level: `level.json` plus one file per stored layer, `entities.json` and `notes.json`.

depth.description: Draw order in the world view; higher is in front.

fields.description: Values for the project's `level_fields`, by field slug.

layers.description:
Per-layer rule state by `auto` layer slug. A layer without an entry
has seed 0, no optional groups and no tileset substitutions.

size.description:
`[width, height]` in cells of the project grid. Layers with their own
grid size cover the same pixels.

slug.description: Same as the directory name; also the Godot room name.

tags.description:
Free tags (`knowledge`), the same vocabulary as annotation tags.
Non-empty, no repeats (validation).

title: Worlds level file
